title: MacSteam Save Boundary
description: Schema for save data boundary discovery results describing which paths contain game save data

schemaVersion.description: Schema version identifier; must be 1 for this schema revision

gameId.description: Identifier of the game whose save data boundaries are being described

confidence.description: Overall confidence level in the save boundary discovery

candidates.description: Candidate save data paths with individual confidence levels

relativePath.description: Relative path to a candidate save data location

confidence.description: Confidence level for this specific candidate

description.description: Human-readable description of what this candidate path represents

discoveredAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this save boundary was determined
